verbs.name: quit
verbs.description: Exit the application

verbs.name: get
verbs.description: the value at a path, keys in document order; a [] path answers an array of every value it names

verbs.name: rows
verbs.description: doc table's rows as JSON Lines {noun: item, id: PATH, data: ITEM, cells}, one cell per doc table column; --format table, markdown and toon print them as a table

verbs.name: structure
verbs.description: the document's shape as a tree of {key, path, count, of, types, min_items, max_items, optional, children}; fields most common first, optional ones last

verbs.name: aliases
verbs.description: List every action alias: the framework's old names, the application's aliases and the alias rows of actions.json, each with the action it runs

verbs.name: check
verbs.description: Report the entries of actions.json a load would skip, alias rows that clash with an action or another alias included, without installing anything

verbs.name: list
verbs.description: List the actions installed from actions.json: verbs that run an external command

verbs.name: check
verbs.description: Report the rows of the user bindings file that would be skipped, any merged row that does not validate, and as warnings the file's guard rows (debts) and any row that can never answer; with debts, every guard row of every table too; the status line names the format read (grouped or rows)

verbs.name: defaults
verbs.description: Print the default bindings (the framework's and the application's, without the user's bindings.json) as a bindings file, each group tagged with its source: the embedded file, go or generated

verbs.name: export
verbs.description: Write every stored key row to a file in the grouped bindings format (what config export writes as bindings.reference.json); never over the live bindings.json without force

verbs.name: mode
verbs.description: Choose the mode the help's pick view describes

verbs.name: noun
verbs.description: Choose the noun the help's pick and table views describe

verbs.name: place
verbs.description: Choose where the help's pick and table views put the noun: one of the places it was seen (the page, the levels above it, the modal), or none (the noun and app)

verbs.name: cancel
verbs.description: Close without choosing

verbs.name: move
verbs.description: Move the highlight; from none, 1 lands on the first row and -1 stays

verbs.name: next-source
verbs.description: Show the next source's rows; the query stays

verbs.name: accept
verbs.description: Replace the token with the highlighted suggestion, else the first, keeping its trigger; one undoable edit

verbs.name: dismiss
verbs.description: Hide the suggestions; the input stays in its mode and typing reopens them

verbs.name: move
verbs.description: Move the suggestion highlight; from none, 1 lands on the first and -1 stays

verbs.name: export
verbs.description: Write a reference of the user configuration (every setting, every key row) into a directory, default <config dir>/reference; never over the live files without force

verbs.name: path
verbs.description: Print the config directory (bindings.json, settings.json, actions.json, themes.json), the state directory (history.jsonl, panes.json) and the default config export directory

verbs.name: reload
verbs.description: Read every config file again: themes.json, settings.json, actions.json, bindings.json, segments.json, then the application's own; a bad file or entry is skipped and reported
